blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — More than 600 metal detectors will be distributed to public high schools in Cebu Province to strengthen security at school entrances. The Cebu Provincial Government said 615 schools with perimeter fences will receive the equipment for inspecting students, personnel, and visitors.
